notes: The Payment Log now lives near the top of the Dashboard, right after your charts - you add debts once, but you log payments forever.
Undo for payments: after logging, a small toast appears for a few seconds with an Undo button, so a fat-fingered amount is one tap to reverse.

Performance: the Dashboard now runs one shared payoff simulation per refresh instead of seven identical ones, and the What-If sliders wait for your thumb to settle before recalculating - dragging is now smooth on phones and iPads.
The premium Cash-Flow and Roadmap cards now tuck themselves away when you're down to your final debt instead of showing a nearly-empty chart.
